description: Fastest inference in the world for the 12 billion parameter FLUX.1 [schnell] text-to-image model.

input_params.name: prompt
input_params.description: The prompt to generate an image from.

input_params.name: seed
input_params.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model
        will output the same image every time.

input_params.name: image_size
input_params.description: The size of the generated image.

input_params.name: num_inference_steps
input_params.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

input_params.name: guidance_scale
input_params.description:
The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want
        the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

input_params.name: sync_mode
input_params.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

input_params.name: output_format
input_params.description: The format of the generated image.

input_params.name: acceleration
input_params.description: The speed of the generation. The higher the speed, the faster the generation.

input_params.name: enable_safety_checker
input_params.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.

input_params.name: num_images
input_params.description: The number of images to generate.

output_fields.name: seed
output_fields.description:
Seed of the generated Image. It will be the same value of the one passed in the
            input or the randomly generated that was used in case none was passed.

output_fields.name: prompt
output_fields.description: The prompt used for generating the image.

output_fields.name: has_nsfw_concepts
output_fields.description: Whether the generated images contain NSFW concepts.

examples: Extreme close-up of a single tiger eye, direct frontal view. Detailed iris and pupil. Sharp focus on eye texture and color. Natural lighting to capture authentic eye shine and depth. The word "FLUX" is painted over it in big, white brush strokes with visible texture.

selection_guidance: To choose a model for a task, call recommend_model: it applies current published guidance, checks fit and returns next_call with an input contract. Catalog order is not a quality ranking. Copy endpoint_id exactly; never add or change a provider prefix such as fal-ai/.

evidence.latency_definition: Successful execution observations in milliseconds; mixed workloads; excludes queue/startup; not runtime guarantees.
evidence.instructions: Successful execution observations in milliseconds; mixed workloads; excludes queue/startup; not runtime guarantees. Report p50/p90 with their measurement window. Null means unknown, never zero. Trending is the analytics category rank at its source timestamp, not adoption or quality. New means registry publication within 30 days of the response evaluation time, not first usage. Lab recommendations are authored guidance, not measured latency, trending or newness.
